en_title: GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Actors Spotted Together in First Photo
cn_title: 《GTA6》的Jason与Lucia扮演者首次同框合影曝光
opus_summary: 《GTA6》Lucia的演员Manni L. Perez与Jason的演员Dylan Rourke首次同框，两人在游戏巨幅广告牌前与Lucia的特技替身Victoria Lee合影。Lee在Instagram分享照片，并表示自己还参与了游戏中其他角色的特技表演。

paragraphs.en: The actors behind GTA 6 protagonists Jason and Lucia have finally been pictured together, after years of speculation regarding their identities.
paragraphs.cn: 在外界对《GTA6》主角Jason和Lucia的扮演者身份猜测多年之后，两位演员终于同框合影。

paragraphs.en: As we learned earlier this week, Lucia is played by Manni L. Perez — though this casting was only confirmed as the actress received a Game Awards nomination for her work.
paragraphs.cn: 正如我们在本周早些时候得知的，Lucia由Manni L. Perez饰演——不过，直到这位演员凭借该角色获得游戏大奖提名时，这一选角才得到确认。

paragraphs.en: Now, we can see Jason actor Dylan Rourke revealed and in the flesh too, sharing a hug with Perez and her stunt double Victoria Lee, while standing in front of a giant Grand Theft Auto 6 billboard.
paragraphs.cn: 现在，我们也终于见到了Jason的扮演者Dylan Rourke本人：他站在一块巨大的《GTA6》广告牌前，与Perez及其特技替身Victoria Lee拥抱。

paragraphs.en: "Well... the secret's finally out!" Lee posted on Instagram today. "After keeping my mouth shut for YEEAARRSSS (and what feels like FOREVER!!! 😂), I can finally share that I've been lucky enough to help bring LUCIA to life as her MAIN STUNT DOUBLE in GRAND THEFT AUTO 6, along with a whole bunch of other characters stunts along the way!"
paragraphs.cn: Lee今天在Instagram上发文称：「好了……秘密终于公开了！在我守口如瓶好多好多年之后（感觉像是过了一辈子！！！😂），我终于可以告诉大家，我非常幸运地在《GTA6》中担任LUCIA的主要特技替身，帮助塑造了这个角色，同时还为许多其他角色完成了特技动作！」

paragraphs.en: Lee's photo is the first time we've seen Rourke publicly confirmed to be playing Jason, although his name has been circulating online over the past 24 hours from some who had received early copies of the game. Regardless, this is our first chance to see the real-life Jason and Lucia together, after years and years of Rockstar secrecy keeping their identities under wraps.
paragraphs.cn: Lee的照片是我们第一次看到Rourke饰演Jason得到公开确认，尽管在过去24小时里，一些提前拿到游戏的人已在网上传播他的名字。无论如何，在Rockstar多年来对两人的身份严格保密之后，这是我们第一次有机会看到现实中的Jason和Lucia同框。

paragraphs.en: "Thousands of hours, countless memories, and one HELL of a ride!" Lee continued. "The amount of blood, sweat, tears, and IMPACT that went into bringing this world to life is unreal! Oh, and did I mention the impact?!... Yeah, that s***'s REAL!!! 😂💥😵‍💫
paragraphs.cn: Lee接着说：「数千个小时，无数的回忆，还有一段他妈的精彩旅程！为了让这个世界栩栩如生，付出的鲜血、汗水、泪水，以及承受的冲击，多得令人难以置信！哦，我提到冲击了吗？！……没错，那他妈可是真的！！！😂💥😵‍💫

paragraphs.en: "So many incredibly talented people poured their hearts and souls into this game, and I'm beyond grateful to have been part of something so massive! A special shoutout to Manni and Dylan! ❤️ You two are truly amazing humans, inside and out! So much talent, heart, and genuine goodness. I'm forever grateful to have shared this wild ride with you both! Thank you for being so freaking awesome! ❤️❤️❤️
paragraphs.cn: 「许多才华横溢的人为这款游戏倾注了全部心血，能够参与如此宏大的项目，我感激不尽！特别感谢Manni和Dylan！❤️ 你们两人由内而外都是非常棒的人！才华横溢，满怀热忱，真诚善良。能与你们共同经历这段疯狂旅程，我将永远心怀感激！谢谢你们这么他妈的出色！❤️❤️❤️

paragraphs.en: "To everyone who helped make this game possible, thank you for an unforgettable experience! ❤️ And to everyone about to experience Vice City… **BUCKLE UP, BITCHESSSSS!!!!!!!** 😈🔥 **WELCOME TO VICE CITY!!!**"
paragraphs.cn: 「感谢所有帮助这款游戏得以实现的人，谢谢你们带来了这段难忘的经历！❤️ 至于即将体验Vice City的各位……**系好安全带，混蛋们！！！！！！！** 😈🔥 **欢迎来到Vice City！！！**」

paragraphs.en: Like Perez, Rourke is an actor with a history of TV guest roles in series you'll have heard of, including Modern Family and Grey's Anatomy — though no real breakout appearances to date. Of course, all of that has now changed with the actor fronting one of the biggest entertainment releases of all time.
paragraphs.cn: 和Perez一样，Rourke也曾在一些你可能听说过的电视剧中客串，包括《摩登家庭》和《实习医生格蕾》——不过迄今为止，他还没有真正凭借哪个角色崭露头角。当然，随着他主演了有史以来规模最大的娱乐作品之一，这一切现在都改变了。

If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA6》，或者不知道接下来该做什么？不妨在IGN查看《GTA6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过《新手指南——67条提示与技巧》了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或通过《第一章指南与提示》和《第二章指南与提示》了解开篇章节的全部细节。如果你已经开车游遍Leonida，想知道所有可供发现和游玩的内容，可以查看Leonida互动地图。
